CHAPTER.VERS: Praise YAH! Praise the name of Jehovah; praise Him, O you servants of Jehovah!
You who stand in the house of Jehovah, in the courts of the house of our God,
praise YAH, for Jehovah is good; make music unto His name, for it is delightful.
For YAH has chosen Jacob unto Himself, Israel for His valued treasure.
For I know that Jehovah is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever Jehovah pleases, He does in the heavens and in earth, in the seas and in all deep places.
He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain; He brings the wind out of His storehouses.
He has struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck many nations and slew mighty kings;
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
and gave their land as a heritage, a heritage to Israel His people.
Your name, O Jehovah, is eternal, Your remembrance, O Jehovah, from generation to generation.
For Jehovah will judge His people, and He will have compassion on His servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of mens hands.
They have mouths, but they do not speak; eyes they have, but they do not see;
they have ears, but they do not hear; nor is there any breath in their mouths.
Those who make them are like them; everyone who trusts in them.
Bless Jehovah, O house of Israel! Bless Jehovah, O house of Aaron!
Bless Jehovah, O house of Levi! You who fear Jehovah, bless Jehovah!
Blessed is Jehovah out of Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem! Praise YAH!
